scope: two-seed still-image diagnosis; regions include background and are not segmentation masks

broad_sun.scope: private lighting alternative; not a new default

limitations: Two seeds measure these realizations, not population variance or optical accuracy
White-pixel persistence alone does not certify a highlight
Selected unstable/persistent pixels are illustrative extremes, not representative averages
Private sample-series means must match ordinary HDR before interpretation
No clamp, denoiser, lighting or sampling default was changed
